description: This Java class defines the OpenAPIDefinition used in the mockserver project to specify OpenAPI specifications for request matching, including methods for creation, cloning, updating, and equality checks.

classes.name: OpenAPIDefinition
classes.description: Represents an OpenAPI specification with methods to create, clone, update, and compare instances, used for request matching in mockserver.

methods.name: openAPI
methods.description: Factory methods to create OpenAPIDefinition instances with specified URL/payload and optional operationId.

methods.name: getSpecUrlOrPayload
methods.description: Returns the OpenAPI specification URL or payload.

methods.name: withSpecUrlOrPayload
methods.description: Sets the OpenAPI URL or payload for the instance.

methods.name: getOperationId
methods.description: Returns the operationId associated with the OpenAPI.

methods.name: withOperationId
methods.description: Sets the operationId for the OpenAPI.

methods.name: shallowClone
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the OpenAPIDefinition instance.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the current instance with non-null, non-blank values from another OpenAPIDefinition.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on URL/payload and operationId.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on super, URL/payload, and operationId.
